title: Zone-aware fast-fail probe and soft-commit reconciler
author: Aisha Raman
description:
Motivation: Dedicated clusters occasionally experience zone-level degradation (network flaps, node oom, localized NVLink saturation) that manifests as sudden request-level latency spikes and transient SLA violations. Current autoscaler reacts slowly because it aggregates across the entire fleet. This PR adds a lightweight zone-aware fast-fail probe and a conservative "soft-commit" reconciler to reduce time-to-respond for localized failures while avoiding aggressive decommit churn.

Summary of changes: implement a fast health probe that runs in the autoscaler control loop to detect high tail latency and error spikes scoped to availability zones; introduce a soft-commit reconciler that marks a subset of reserved capacity as "reconciling" before fully deallocating to allow graceful request draining and cross-zone spillover; wire new telemetry (zone_headroom, zone_probe_latency_p95, soft_commit_evictions) into Console dashboards; add unit and integration tests and a small canary rollout plan.

Design notes: the fast-fail probe uses exponential moving percentiles of p95 latency and 5xx rate per zone with a short 30s evaluation window and an elevated threshold for zones that historically show variance. On detection we set a local soft-throttle signal that will: 1) divert new best-effort requests off the zone via the routing policy, 2) trigger the reconciler to begin marking warm-pool slots as soft-commit instead of immediate release. Soft-commit retains existing node allocations for a configurable grace window (default 90s) allowing KV cache reuse and draining in-flight requests. The reconciler performs a two-phase decommit: mark -> observe -> evict, with an early-abort if zone metrics recover.

Backward compatibility: default behavior is off for Dedicated clusters older than the autoscaler v2 config. Behavior is opt-in via a cluster-level flag: enable_zone_fastfail=true. The reconciler respects existing reservation guarantees and will not violate tenant throughput contracts; it only acts on ephemeral warm/pool capacity and opportunistic slots.

Testing and telemetry: added unit tests for probe threshold logic and reconciler state machine. Integration tests simulate zone latency spikes using the perf-canary harness and assert <30s median mitigation time. Telemetry added to shed insight into zone-level headroom, probe firings, and soft-commit evictions. Alerts: added an SLO alert rule to track repeated probe firings (>3 in 10m).

Rollout plan: canary enabled on 5% of Dedicated clusters for 48h, monitor soft_commit_evictions and tenant SLA delta; if anomalies observed revert via the feature flag.

Related: ENG-1892 (zone resiliency), ENG-2034 (soft decommit proposal).

Benji Park: telemetry looks good; add a label to differentiate probe firings from reconciler-initiated evictions (requested change)

release_notes: Add optional zone-aware fast-fail detection for Dedicated autoscaler and a soft-commit reconciler to reduce disruption during localized zone issues. Opt-in via 'enable_zone_fastfail' flag. Improves mitigation latency for zone degradations and reduces immediate decommit churn.
canary_plan: Enable on 5% of Dedicated clusters for 48h, monitor soft_commit_evictions, reconciler_eviction_count, zone_headroom and tenant SLA delta; rollback if SLA delta > 1.5% or probe firings > 10 per cluster per hour.
observability_changes: New metrics: zone_probe_p95, zone_probe_5xx_rate, zone_headroom, probe_initiated_soft_evictions, reconciler_eviction_count. Dashboard panel: Dedicated -> Zone health and soft-commit activity.
backout_plan: Flip feature flag in deploy/feature_flags.yaml to disable_zone_fastfail, which short-circuits probe and reconciler immediately. If needed, rollback last release to main. Monitoring alert to trigger paging on unexpected increases in evictions.
